items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I left Minneapolis and saw him with Buddy Rogers... I would be playing the drums downstairs

ctx.x: This is a word game - you name the band. Gene Krupa?

Gene, really the first time that he took my notice was when he was with Buddy Rogers. You know, Buddy was playing the multiple, and he'd run around and play all the instruments; and I'm in Minneapolis looking at him. I was late on my job, the first time in my life I was ever late on my job with Grant Moore, watching Gene. I went back stage and saw him. Then I found out about some of his background and who he hung out with and he knew about everybody else, but I said social conditions being what they were. Then…
